purpose: y2s67-libmerge1: libredwoodair.dylib only = the y2s47 library 6df1af45 + thumbrc (one IOSurface import per Mesa screen; 'np import/close' log, first 48) + camstats (GPU frame statistics for the camera ISP, rwa_isp_output.stats; API version 1, no log) + GNR1 ('np GNR1 FAULT' decode, 'GNR1 FAILED DISPATCH' bindings, 'GNR1 dispatch' trace with /var/db/nord2-gpu-gnr1-trace, which the guest creates when absent, marker gnr1-trace.made-by-libmerge1). Built in gpu/build/y2s67-libmerge1 (src, libmerge1.diff); control build of the base reproduces 6df1af45 and Nord2Metal 92e85b54. Accepts as 'from' the base or any of the three variants; the previous one is recorded in receipt.json 'libmerge1' and backed up as libredwoodair.dylib.pre-libmerge1. Nord2Metal must be y2s65-thumbsync (92e85b54), unchanged. Undo: guest-libmerge1-undo.sh restores the recorded previous library.
